content.comment_body: I forgot the access password for [product_name] and now I cannot log in. Although I deleted the program directly from the device, it did not resolve the issue. When I go to the tools - transfers - factory settings tab, it still asks for the password. Is there an alternative method to reset to factory settings? I am using [product_name] version [version_no].

I'm not sure why you posted twice—first in another topic (34th reply) about disabling password protection in [product_name], and now as a separate thread. In your initial post, you didn't mention that your device does not have a display. It looks like the forum is unable to provide a solution in this case. You may want to initiate a support request.
Closed as the question was posted twice. The other thread titled 'Can't access [product_name]' is published within the [product_name] - Software conference. Best regards, [user_name]

analysis.insight_summary: Users experience challenges when forgetting the password for [product_name], as password prompts are required both for access and factory reset processes, resulting in being unable to regain access. The available methods still demand the password, and neither the product nor forum replies offer a workaround. This shows limitations in current recovery procedures within the software.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect to be able to reset the device to factory settings or remove password protection without needing the forgotten password, allowing them to recover access to the device.
